title: Score Big with ‘Stay Live’: A More Immersive Way to Reach Sports & Entertainment Audiences
summary: At Perion, we are excited to introduce “Stay Live,” our innovative ad format for live Connected TV (CTV) broadcasts.
body_markdown:
At Perion, we are excited to introduce “Stay Live,” our innovative ad format for live Connected TV (CTV) broadcasts. This new feature, previously exclusive to select advertisers, dynamically integrates brand ads directly into sports and entertainment programming, including live games, re-airs and studio shows. Designed to engage viewers during key moments with minimal disruption, Stay Live is initially launched for sports and eSports broadcasts.


**Alignment with the Football Season**


The new format is perfectly timed for the football season. Advertisers can now align their brands with the excitement of the game. Imagine your brand message appearing during replays after a player scores a touchdown. AI-powered technology analyzes the live stream, identifying the lull in the action after these pivotal moments in real-time to optimize ad placements for maximum impact and viewer engagement.


This offering not only enhances the viewer experience but also allows advertisers to deliver resonant messages at moments of peak engagement. As a result, ads feel like a natural part of the broadcast, keeping viewers immersed rather than interrupting them.


**Technology and Development**


Stay Live combines[Perion’s CTV advertising](https://perion.com/connected-tv/) capabilities with AI-powered technology to create engaging and immersive advertising experiences across sports and entertainment programming. By analyzing content in real time, the technology identifies natural pauses, low-action moments, and key events, such as touchdowns, home runs, or free throws, creating opportunities to integrate ads at relevant moments with minimal disruption to the viewing experience.


This gives brands a way to reach engaged audiences while keeping their message visible alongside the content. Rather than cutting away to traditional commercial breaks, Stay Live keeps the game on screen while brands capture viewers’ attention.


**Meeting the Live Sports Opportunity**


“Live sports provides advertisers opportunities to reach targeted audiences like no other,” said Todd Cohen, Vice President of CTV Sales and Strategy at Perion.


“With viewers leaned into the game, it offers key moments to deliver an ad that will capture attention. But it needs to be done in a way that doesn’t hinder their viewing experience. With Stay Live, we are making it possible to integrate ads seamlessly in a way that enhances, rather than disrupts, the viewing experience. This approach benefits consumers, advertisers, and broadcasters alike.”


“We make significant investments in sports on linear TV, but were looking for something new and exciting, and this was definitely it,” said Olivia Sutherland, Senior TV Growth Marketing Associate at DraftKings, an early adopter of our Stay Live Sports format. “With Perion’s[Stay Live CTV](https://perion.com/channels/ctv/) , our ads are integrated into the game broadcast, making them nearly unmissable! We loved that we could feature our CTV spots, coupled with the addition of custom backgrounds that showcase our logo and key messaging. It was a no-brainer.”


**Pause Ad Expansion**


In addition to Stay Live, we are also making our Pause Ad format, which has been available on a select basis, available to all sports advertisers. Our unique Pause Ads feature non-disruptive ads that activate when users pause their CTV viewing experience, reaching viewers during non-traditional ad moments across live, VOD, and DVR content.
